pages.title: block.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_imbuement_core
pages.text: The Arcane Imbuement Core is a standalone bulk Source Gem converter. It does not use an Imbuement Chamber or ordinary imbuement recipes. Use a Dominion Wand to bind output first and input second; sneak-use clears its links.

pages.title: block.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_imbuement_core
pages.text: Each five-second cycle processes up to four inputs. Lapis Lazuli or an Amethyst Shard costs 500 Source and yields one Source Gem. A Lapis Block yields nine, while an Amethyst Block yields four.

The Core takes block ingredients before loose ones. Empty-hand use switches between loose and compact output. Compact mode turns each four Gems into one Source Gem Block and keeps any remainder. Redstone pauses processing.
